items.name: adrock
items.note: A yellow rope hangs down on a teal-green background; a little figure in a white jumpsuit slides down the rope, comes to a stop and blinks.
items.use: Suited to transition entrances, character reveals or humorous notification motion graphics.

items.name: bodymovin
items.description: Bodymovin wordmark animation, horizontal bar shape, suitable as a title
items.note: Yellow English letters on a green bar break apart into colored geometric fragments and morph, then reassemble into the original word.
items.use: Suited to intro title displays, LOGO reveals or transitional bridges.

items.name: gatin
items.note: A white kitten sits upright inside an orange square, alternately closing its eyes, opening its mouth and swishing its tail.
items.use: Suited to pet life logs, cute-style illustrations or emotion-expression stickers.

items.name: happy2016
items.description: New Year greeting-card style 2016 number animation, full screen 16:9
items.note: Multicolor-striped HAPPY letters wobble and morph on a cream-yellow background, smoothly turning into the colorful number 2016.
items.use: Suited to New Year greetings, New Year's Eve celebrations or holiday intro countdowns.

items.name: navidad
items.note: A red circle on a dark background morphs in turn into a Christmas hat, Santa Claus, a Christmas tree and a colorful wreath.
items.use: Suited to Christmas promotions, winter party intros or greeting-card motion graphics.
